rows.note: Use this for accountability in public bodies, institutions, or official responsibility, especially in phrases such as 問責制度.

example.english: The accountability system ensures officials have to answer to the public when they make mistakes.
example.traditional: 問責制度保障官員做錯事要向市民交代。
example.jyutping: man6 zaak3 zai3 dou6 bou2 zoeng3 gun1 jyun4 zou6 co3 si6 jiu3 hoeng3 si5 man4 gaau1 doi6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction when someone must answer to another person or explain their actions.

example.english: I need to take accountability and explain this mess to my boss.
example.traditional: 今次搞成咁，我要向老闆交代。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 gaau2 sing4 gam3 ngo5 jiu3 hoeng3 lou5 baan2 gaau1 doi6
